description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_DateTime, which represents an XML-RPC dateTime value within the Zend Framework. It extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar and provides functionality to initialize dateTime values from various inputs and return the stored date/time as a string.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_DateTime
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC dateTime value, capable of initializing from various formats and outputting the value as a string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dateTime value from various input types, such as Zend_Date, DateTime, numeric timestamps, or strings parsable by strtotime().

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the date/time as a string in the internal format.
